# `filter`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Filters the input array using the given predicate.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
filter(expr, func)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- filter, example 1
> SELECT filter(array(1, 2, 3), x -> x % 2 == 1);
[1,3]
```

```sql
-- filter, example 2
> SELECT filter(array(0, 2, 3), (x, i) -> x > i);
Error: INVALID_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_CALL.NUM_ARGS_MISMATCH
```

```sql
-- filter, example 3
> SELECT filter(array(0, null, 2, 3, null), x -> x IS NOT NULL);
[0,2,3]
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
